findings.title: Invalid Ruby syntax `<%- end if %>` in ERB template causes SyntaxError
findings.body: Line 6 closes the `if @topic_view.posts.present?` block with `<%- end if %>` instead of `<%- end %>`. In Ruby, `end if` is not valid syntax for closing an `if` block (it is parsed as `end` followed by a trailing `if` modifier with a missing condition), so rendering `app/views/embed/best.html.erb` will raise a `SyntaxError` whenever an embedded topic is viewed.

findings.title: Unvalidated `open(url)` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` allows local file read / SSRF and lacks `require 'open-uri'`
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.import_remote` calls `open(url).read` without requiring `'open-uri'` (which is only required in `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`) and without validating the URL scheme. First, when `import_remote` is called from `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` (when `feed_polling_enabled` is false) or `disqus.thor`, `open-uri` may not be loaded, causing `Kernel#open` to treat `url` as a file path and raise `Errno::ENOENT`. Second, `TopicEmbed.import` only checks `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` after `import_remote` has already called `open(url).read`, and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` only checks `URI(@embed_url).host` without checking `URI(@embed_url).scheme`. A protocol-relative URL such as `//<embeddable_host>/etc/passwd` passes the host check in `TopicRetriever` and causes `Kernel#open` to read arbitrary files from the server filesystem (and if `import_remote` is called with a leading pipe character, `Kernel#open` will execute shell commands).

findings.title: Stored XSS via unescaped `url` and unsanitized HTML with `raw_html` cook method
findings.body: `Post#cook` bypasses the entire sanitization and rendering pipeline when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, returning `raw` verbatim. In `TopicEmbed.import`, `url` is interpolated directly into `#{url}` without HTML/attribute escaping, and `Jobs::PollFeed` passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` directly into `TopicEmbed.import` without HTML sanitization. Because `EmbedController#best` allows any unauthenticated user to enqueue `RetrieveTopic` for any `embed_url` whose host matches `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, a URL containing characters valid in Ruby's `URI.parse` such as single quotes (e.g. `http://example.com/post?'onmouseover='alert(1)`) will break out of the `href` attribute and store arbitrary JavaScript in the cooked post.

findings.title: `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` on standard RSS 2.0 feeds where `content` is `nil`
findings.body: In `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed`, `i.content.scrub` assumes every feed item has a non-nil `content` attribute. In `SimpleRSS`, standard RSS 2.0 feeds populate `i.description` (or `i.content_encoded`) rather than `i.content` (which is only populated for Atom `<content>` elements). When polling an RSS 2.0 feed or an Atom entry without `<content>`, `i.content` is `nil`, causing `i.content.scrub` to raise `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass` and abort the job.

findings.title: `absolutize_urls` corrupts protocol-relative URLs starting with `//`
findings.body: In `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls`, links and images are checked with `href.start_with?('/')` and `src.start_with?('/')`, and then rewritten using `"#{prefix}/#{href.sub(/^\/+/, '')}"`. Protocol-relative URLs (such as `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg`) also start with `'/'`, so all leading slashes are stripped and the embed host is prepended, turning `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` into `http://<embed_host>/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`.

findings.title: `TopicEmbed.import` does not handle failed post creation or soft-deleted embedded posts
findings.body: In `TopicEmbed.import`, `post = creator.create` returns the unsaved `Post` instance even if `PostCreator#create` rolled back (for example, when `rollback_if_host_spam_detected` triggers because `skip_validations` does not bypass the host spam check). Because `post.present?` is `true` for an unsaved ActiveRecord object (`post.id` is `nil`), `TopicEmbed.create!` is called with `post_id: nil`, raising a database `NOT NULL` constraint violation. Similarly, in the `else` branch on line 32, if the previously created post was soft-deleted, `embed.post` returns `nil` and `PostRevisor.new(post).revise!` raises `NoMethodError`.

findings.title: Unescaped/HTML-escaped `request.referer` in `<script>` corrupts `postMessage` `targetOrigin`
findings.body: In `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb`, `<%= request.referer %>` is interpolated directly into a JavaScript string literal passed as `targetOrigin` to `parent.postMessage`. Because ERB applies HTML entity escaping (`&` -> `&`, `'` -> `'`) which is not decoded inside a `<script>` block, any referer URL containing `'`, `&`, or `\` can produce an invalid `targetOrigin` or break the JavaScript string literal instead of passing the referer's origin.
